transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm just... exhausted. But it's a kind of tired that sleep doesn't really fix. Just getting through a normal workday, and then dinner at home... it just feels heavier than it should. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
I suppose... yeah. Um, most days lately, I just wake up with this... heavy, gray feeling. It's just... like I'm already disappointed in the day before it even starts. So... yes. I guess I have been.
Have you been enjoying things less than you usually do?

Yeah, I suppose. Um... normally I like to paint, or... wander through museum exhibits. But recently... I don't know, my supplies have just been sitting there untouched. I just... can't really make myself care enough to go do any of it right now.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself?
Um... no. No, I haven't. I don't... I don't think about things like that. It's just... I'm just tired, like I said. Not... not wanting to hurt myself.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um... maybe a month? Give or take. I was... well, before this, I was actually really energized. Just... really driven with everything. But then it just kind of... swung the other way. So, yeah. It's been about a month of feeling like this.
During that time before this started, did you feel unusually euphoric or unusually irritable?

Um... I suppose so. Earlier in the month, I was just... very upbeat. Really charged, I guess. I felt like I was having these brilliant ideas. But... well, if my husband started questioning my plans, I... I got irritated pretty fast. So, yeah. Maybe a bit of both.
During that energized period, did you need much less sleep than usual?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. I was only getting... maybe four hours a night? 

But I didn't feel tired. I'd just wake up and... feel ready to go. I'd start sending work emails, or sketching out event ideas. Or I'd just end up... reorganizing the kitchen. I just didn't need as much rest, I guess.
During that energized period, did you feel unusually confident or like you could do things other people couldn’t?

Um... I guess so. I felt pretty capable. I was... honestly convinced I could just fix the whole department's morale problem at work. And... sort out all our family routines at home, too. I just felt like... if everyone would just get on board with my plan, I could handle it all. So, yeah. I felt confident.
During that energized period, were you talking more than usual?

Um... I guess maybe a little. My husband mentioned something about it. And... a couple of people at work, too. They said I was talking really fast... and that they couldn't really get a word in because I kept jumping in. So... yes, I suppose I was.
During that energized period, did it cause serious problems at work or home, or lead to hospitalization?

Um... no, not really. I mean... I didn't end up in the hospital or anything like that. And... I don't think it caused any major issues at work or home. Just... maybe people were a little annoyed with me sometimes, but... no serious problems, I don't think.
About how many days did that unusually energized period last?
Um... I'm not entirely sure, to be honest. It's hard to remember exactly. Maybe... a few days? I didn't really keep track.
Did that unusually energized period last at least 4 days in a row?
Um... I really couldn't say for sure. Like I said, I wasn't counting. It might have been four days... or maybe just three. I just... I don't know.
During that energized period, were you more active or taking on more projects than usual?

Um... I suppose so. I did... sign up to lead some extra pieces of the morale program at work. And... I guess I volunteered for a few more Latino arts events. It was... definitely more than I'd normally take on, but... yeah. I guess I was just keeping busy.
Thinking back to that energized period, what is the longest number of days in a row it lasted?
I... I really don't have an exact number for you. Like I mentioned, I wasn't keeping track of it. It was just... a few days. I don't really know how else to answer that.
Before this past month, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed like this for at least two weeks?
Um... yes. There was a time before. I think... the longest stretch I can remember was maybe about five months. I just... I felt really low and tired most days. It didn't feel like myself.
Before this past month, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt unusually energized or unusually irritable for at least 4 days in a row?
Um... no. Not that I can think of. Just... just the one time recently.
During that energized period, were you functioning noticeably differently from your usual self?
Um... I don't really think so. I mean, I didn't notice a big change or anything. I was just... doing my normal routine, I guess.
Did other people notice that you were acting noticeably differently from your usual self during that energized period?
Um... I'm not really sure. No one... no one said anything to me about it, so I don't think so.
Did that five-month period when you felt very low happen before this current month?
Um... yeah, I suppose so. The longest stretch I can remember... it was about five months. I just felt low and... tired. Not myself most days. But yes, it was before this past month.
During that five-month period, did you also lose interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
Um... yeah, I think so. I usually like painting, or... walking through museum exhibits. But during that time... I just left my supplies untouched. I couldn't really make myself care enough to go.
